name: Osilodrostat

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypocortisolism : Monitor patients closely for hypocortisolism and potentially life-threatening adrenal insufficiency. summary: Warnings for Osilodrostat note that patients should be monitored closely for hypocortisolism, a condition involving abnormally low cortisol levels, as well as potentially life-threatening adrenal insufficiency where the adrenal glands do not make enough hormones [3]. If these issues occur, a doctor may need to reduce the dose or interrupt treatment, and low cortisol levels might continue even after stopping the drug [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated medium-risk scores of 60 for the liver and 64 for the heart [M].
